source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps both senders, slave status, the whole community and its named offices.
key_decisions.before: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
key_decisions.after: From Paul and Timothy, slaves of Christ Jesus, to all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:

key_decisions.rationale: Makes the remembrance idiom natural; the alternative direction is noted.
key_decisions.before: I thank my God every time I remember you,
key_decisions.after: I thank my God whenever I remember you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I give thanks to my God every time I remember you,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps divine initiative, communal scope and the named future day.
key_decisions.before: I am confident of this: the one who began a good work among you will bring it to completion by the day of Christ Jesus.
key_decisions.after: I am sure of this: the one who began a good work among you will bring it to completion by the day of Christ Jesus.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I am confident of this: that the one who began a good work among you will bring it to completion at the day of Jesus Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Splits the long sentence while preserving all, shared grace and both settings.
key_decisions.before: It is right for me to think this way about all of you, because I hold you in my heart. All of you share grace with me, both in my imprisonment and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel.
key_decisions.after: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, because I hold you in my heart. All of you share in grace with me, both in my imprisonment and in defending and confirming the good news.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: It is right for me to think this way about all of you, because I hold you in my heart, for all of you share with me in grace, both in my imprisonment and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel.

key_decisions.rationale: Expresses the bodily affection idiom without reducing the intensity or its Christ relation.
key_decisions.before: God is my witness how deeply I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
key_decisions.after: God is my witness to how I long for all of you with the deep affection of Christ Jesus.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For God is my witness, how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps increasing love joined to knowledge and perception.
key_decisions.before: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and every kind of discernment,
key_decisions.after: And this is my prayer: that your love may overflow more and more in knowledge and every kind of discernment,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound still more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

key_decisions.rationale: Makes the purpose and discernment clear while retaining the future horizon.
key_decisions.before: so that you may discern what truly matters and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
key_decisions.after: so that you can recognize what matters most and be sincere and blameless for the day of Christ,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that you may discern what truly matters, and so be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the fruit image, mediated righteousness and divine glory.
key_decisions.before: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
key_decisions.after: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to God's glory and praise.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the imprisonment and its Christ-related cause; guard/place ambiguity is noted.
key_decisions.before: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole imperial guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ,
key_decisions.after: It has become clear throughout the whole imperial guard, and to everyone else, that I am in chains because of Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that it has become known throughout the whole imperial guard and to all the rest that my imprisonment is for Christ;

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps most rather than many, the causal chains and increased boldness.
key_decisions.before: and most of the brothers and sisters have become more confident in the Lord because of my imprisonment and are much more daring in speaking the word without fear.
key_decisions.after: And most of the brothers and sisters, gaining confidence in the Lord through my chains, now dare more than ever to speak the word without fear.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and most of the brothers and sisters, having become confident in the Lord through my imprisonment, dare all the more to speak the word without fear.

key_decisions.rationale: Clarifies the latter referent while keeping appointed/placed language open.
key_decisions.before: The latter do so out of love, knowing that I am here for the defense of the gospel.
key_decisions.after: The latter act out of love, knowing that I am placed here to defend the good news.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The latter do so out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the harmful intention and its relation to imprisonment.
key_decisions.before: The former proclaim Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, thinking they can add trouble to my imprisonment.
key_decisions.after: The others proclaim Christ out of selfish ambition, without sincere motives, thinking they can add to my distress in prison.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The former proclaim Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, thinking to afflict me in my imprisonment.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains salvation rather than guaranteeing release from prison and keeps both means.
key_decisions.before: because I know that this will turn out for my deliverance through your prayers and the help of the Spirit of Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.after: because I know that through your prayers and the help of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, this will lead to my salvation.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For I know that this will turn out for my deliverance through your prayers and the help of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps bodily witness and both possible outcomes without resolving the tension.
key_decisions.before: My eager expectation and hope is that I will not be put to shame in anything, but that with complete boldness, now as always, Christ will be exalted in my body, whether through life or through death.
key_decisions.after: My eager expectation and hope is that I will not be put to shame in any way, but that with complete boldness, now as always, Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: according to my eager expectation and hope that I will not be put to shame in anything, but that with all boldness, now as always, Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the aphorism's terse parallelism.
key_decisions.before: For to me, to live is Christ and to die is gain.
key_decisions.after: For to me, living is Christ and dying is gain.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For to me, to live is Christ and to die is gain.

key_decisions.rationale: Makes the conditional understandable while retaining flesh and unresolved choice.
key_decisions.before: If I continue living in the flesh, that means fruitful work for me. Yet I do not know which I would choose.
key_decisions.after: But if I go on living in the flesh, that means fruitful work for me. Which I would choose, I do not know.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If I am to live on in the flesh, that means fruitful labor for me; and I do not know which I should choose.

key_decisions.rationale: Carries the pressure and comparative intensity without explaining the manner of departure.
key_decisions.before: I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better,
key_decisions.after: I am pulled in both directions. I long to depart and be with Christ, for that is far better;
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I am hard pressed between the two: my desire is to depart and be with Christ, for that is far better;

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the community's need as the counterweight to personal desire.
key_decisions.before: but to remain in the flesh is more necessary for your sake.
key_decisions.after: yet remaining in the flesh is more necessary for your sake.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but to remain in the flesh is more necessary for your sake.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains civic language, common struggle and spirit/soul imagery without deciding the spirit's referent.
key_decisions.before: Only live as citizens in a way worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you or remain absent, I may hear that you are standing firm in one spirit, striving together with one mind for the faith of the gospel,
key_decisions.after: Only, live as citizens worthy of the good news of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or remain absent, I may hear that you stand firm in one spirit, struggling together with one soul for the faith of the good news,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Only live your life in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you or am absent and hear about you, I may know that you are standing firm in one spirit, striving side by side with one mind for the faith of the gospel,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps opposed outcomes and divine origin without specifying the opponents.
key_decisions.before: without being intimidated in any way by your opponents. This is a sign to them of destruction, but to you of salvation—and this is from God.
key_decisions.after: unafraid of your opponents in any way. This is a sign to them of destruction, but of your salvation—and this comes from God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and not intimidated in any way by your opponents. This is a sign of their destruction, but of your salvation—and this is from God.

key_decisions.rationale: Makes the gracious-gift construction audible without making all suffering the same kind.
key_decisions.before: For you have been graciously given, on behalf of Christ, not only to trust in him but also to suffer for him,
key_decisions.after: For you have been given the privilege, for Christ's sake, not only of believing in him but also of suffering for him.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For he has graciously granted you the privilege not only of trusting in Christ, but also of suffering for him,
